'''Mike Bianco''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 2001 Mastic tournament]] on 27 October 2001 with RST Boomrace, according to Sam Diamond's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3080">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-28-mastic-ny-10-27-01-number-1d3080/ mastic-ny-10-27-01-number-1], DeckTech (Sam "AgentSD" Diamond, 28 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-28-mastic-ny-10-27-01-number-1d3080/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
